title.abbrev: Transitive CLEAR DAG Revocation & OT Firewall

front.title: Transitive CLEAR Revocation and Composite Physical-Safety Windows for Multi-Hop Autonomous Agent DAGs

abstract.t: When an orchestrator agent delegates sub-tasks across a multi-hop Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of specialist agents, OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation (RFC 7009) revokes only individual client tokens and provides no mechanism to atomically halt in-flight child, grandchild, or sibling branches or enforce composite time-to-live windows across the entire execution tree. Furthermore, no protocol binds IEC 62443 / Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture (PERA) zone boundaries into agent capability receipts. This document specifies the Transitive CLEAR (Cryptographic Lease Early-Abort & Revocation) DAG protocol and hard Operational Technology (OT) Level 0-2 physical-safety firewalling.

section.name: Introduction and Problem Statement
section.t: In multi-agent workflows, revoking a parent agent's token leaves already-spawned downstream sub-agents free to execute stale tool calls against enterprise or industrial infrastructure. Existing delegation specs lack a transitive DAG epoch heartbeat and a cryptographic Purdue-zone firewall bit that unconditionally blocks autonomous writes to Level 0, Level 1, and Level 2 Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).

This specification complements the foundational execution-trace verification architecture defined in draft-durga-agenttrust-trace-verification-00 by introducing deterministic, fail-closed wire semantics specifically addressing Transitive CLEAR DAG Revocation & OT Firewall.

section.name: Normative Fail-Closed Verification Rules
section.t: Conforming verifiers and relying-party gateways MUST enforce the following deterministic invariants before releasing any downstream side effect:

ol.li: TRANSITIVE_ANCESTOR_REVOCATION: If any ancestor node in dag_root_id broadcasts a signed CLEAR abort frame or increments clear_revocation_epoch, all descendant nodes MUST immediately abort pending tool calls and release held resource leases within one heartbeat interval.

COMPOSITE_WINDOW_CONTAINMENT: At every hop i, the child execution window [start_i, end_i] MUST be a strict subset of its parent's window [start_{i-1}, end_{i-1}], and execution MUST fail closed if current_time > composite_window_end_ms.

OT_PURDUE_L0_L2_FIREWALL: Any agent invocation targeting target_purdue_zone in {PERA_LEVEL_0_PROCESS, PERA_LEVEL_1_BASIC_CONTROL, PERA_LEVEL_2_SUPERVISORY} with effect_class != READ_ONLY MUST be unconditionally rejected by the protocol gateway.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: All pre-image objects MUST be canonicalized using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) prior to signature generation or verification under RFC 8032 Ed25519. Any clock skew exceeding 60 seconds, digest mismatch, or missing cryptographic binding MUST cause the verifier to fail closed and emit an auditable security rejection receipt.
